structure.unit: Licensing for Operation of Coal Mines

law.catch_line: Application for license for the operation of a coal mine

text.section: The application shall be certified as being accurate and complete by the applicant if an individual or by the agent of a corporate applicant or by a general partner of an applicant that is a partnership. The application shall be submitted on forms furnished or approved by the Department.
Within 30 days after the occurrence of any change in the information required by subsection A, the operator shall notify the Department, in writing, of such change.
